notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Atla.
Atla does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Egg creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Egg, adding {C}{C}.
The Egg dies, triggering Atla twice.
Resolve the first Atla trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the second Atla trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card, then putting the creature card onto the battlefield and all other revealed cards on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
